advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: we don't borrow money at all, ever, for anything... the borrower is slave to the lender.
advice_items.summary_en: Never borrow money; grow slowly using organic cash so your business survives downturns.
advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不借贷扩张，靠自有现金流降低风险

advice_items.quote: we began to save and watch the cash flow, and company was growing, and just kept dumping everything we made into this concrete thing here
advice_items.summary_en: Save carefully, monitor cash flow, and continually reinvest business profits into hard assets.
advice_items.summary_zh: 严控现金流并把利润持续复投实体资产

advice_items.quote: pay cash and move slow... if you get one or two properties, pretty quickly they'll throw off enough cash to buy the third one.
advice_items.summary_en: Pay cash for good real estate and let debt-free rental cash flow snowball into additional properties.
advice_items.summary_zh: 全款购入优质房产，靠租金现金流滚雪球

advice_items.quote: Nobody's going to come save you. Nobody's going to come discover you... even if you don't feel good, shut up and go do it anyway.
advice_items.summary_en: Nobody is coming to save or discover you; show up every day and take steady steps regardless of how you feel.
advice_items.summary_zh: 没人会来拯救你，必须每天坚持行动

advice_items.quote: y'all are always looking for an easy button... the best barbecue is cooked the whole weekend not in a microwave.
advice_items.summary_en: Stop searching for an easy button or fast shortcuts; lasting wealth takes slow, patient cooking.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别总想找捷径求快，好成果需要时间慢炖

advice_items.quote: Follow God... The one and only, the great I Am, Jesus.
advice_items.summary_en: Follow God and anchor your life in faith as your core guiding principle.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持对神的信仰，以信仰作为人生指引

guests.first_money_or_break: 20多岁曾一度破产，此后始终坚持无负债创业，靠公司现金流逐步全款买下1000万美元的48英亩土地并自建总部园区，2008年金融危机时用现金以15%-20%的低价抄底大量优质房产。
guests.wealth_detail: Probably a billionaire; ~$850M in real estate (all cash); $300M made at Ramsey this year
guests.zero_start_advice: 坚持全款买房、绝不借贷并稳步推进，靠无债房产的充沛现金流滚雪球买入下一套；不要幻想有人来拯救或发掘你，也别寻找捷径，每天脚踏实地持续行动，保持信仰。

advice_items.quote: Second to last in my class... I'm the only billionaire from my class.
advice_items.summary_en: Do not let poor grades or past academic rankings define your ceiling or future success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别让成绩定义自己，打破局限相信自我

advice_items.quote: Jamie Coulter taught me 1987... he shared with me all his process procedure stuff that he had at his Pizza Huts, and I adapted into the Jimmy John stores.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn from proven operators and adapt their tested processes and procedures into your own stores.
advice_items.summary_zh: 向成功前辈取经并借鉴成熟运营体系

advice_items.quote: if you can't measure it, you can't manage it... Know your numbers. Get your numbers, know them.
advice_items.summary_en: Track and understand every metric in your business because you cannot manage what you cannot measure.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无法衡量就无法管理，必须精通业务数据

advice_items.quote: I do things that I understand. I've got to be able to understand in a single sheet of paper... real estate for me is really easy. Farm ground, I'm a massive farm owner.
advice_items.summary_en: Invest only in simple assets you can understand on a single sheet of paper, such as farmland and real estate.
advice_items.summary_zh: 只投一眼看懂的资产，重仓农田等地产

advice_items.quote: I bet the jockey not the horse... I like to invest in performers. I don't want any stories.
advice_items.summary_en: Bet on driven founders with fire who deliver results rather than people who tell stories and make excuses.
advice_items.summary_zh: 看人下菜碟，只投没有借口的实干派

advice_items.quote: I quit selling and I told people... this is 24/7/365... It was a reverse pitch. The more I told people don't do it, guess what people want to do?
advice_items.summary_en: Stop hard-selling and tell prospects the brutal truth about the grind; an honest reverse pitch drives demand.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用坦诚的逆向推销代替硬推，反促成交

advice_items.quote: work-life balance is the biggest line of [ __ ] that has ever been created... to create something from nothing, there is no such thing
advice_items.summary_en: Reject the myth of work-life balance when building from nothing; outgrind adversity and survive every setback.
advice_items.summary_zh: 白手起家无工作生活平衡，唯有死磕熬过

advice_items.quote: what delivery did is allowed me to pay B and C rent and do A sales cuz I went out and hustled and I went out giving out samples literally on college campuses
advice_items.summary_en: Rent affordable B/C locations and generate A-level revenue by hustling with delivery and disciplined sampling.
advice_items.summary_zh: 租便宜铺面控成本，靠外送地推冲业绩

advice_items.quote: I made a lot of did a lot of stupid [ __ ] but I'm not going there... All we got is this moment right now in the present and I got the future.
advice_items.summary_en: Let go of past mistakes and regrets, forgive, and keep all your focus on the present and future.
advice_items.summary_zh: 放下过去失误与懊悔，专注当下向前看

guests.first_money_or_break: 最初只想赚点钱买大麻和啤酒而创办三明治店；因租不起黄金铺位只能选二三类地段，靠在大学校园发放成千上万份免费试吃并推出极速外送打爆销量；1987年仅4家店时得贵人Jamie Coulter传授流程与数据管理。
guests.wealth_detail: Company valued at ~$3.5B when sold; had $1B net worth before selling
guests.zero_start_advice: 必须量化并掌握核心数据，因为无法衡量就无法管理；从零创业没有工作生活平衡，要做好全年无休死磕的准备；租不起好铺面就靠外送和地推试吃打出顶级业绩；投资只投一页纸能看懂的农田等资产以及没有借口的实干派。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: never just assuming that the spigot is never going to, you know, get shut off or run dry... sock some away for a rainy day because that that rainy day can turn into a rainy decade.
advice_items.summary_en: Never assume good income will last forever; save aggressively because a rainy day can become a rainy decade.
advice_items.summary_zh: 居安思危留足储备，防范漫长低谷期

advice_items.quote: Believing in myself when others didn't. Don't let other people cancel your dreams because they never realized their own.
advice_items.summary_en: Believe in yourself when others doubt you, and never let small-minded doubters cancel your dreams.
advice_items.summary_zh: 遭质疑时坚信自己，别让人否定你梦想

advice_items.quote: Taking risks, doing things that weren't guaranteed, and just always being open to just explore different genres, different avenues, different opportunities
advice_items.summary_en: Take risks on unguaranteed paths and stay open to exploring new genres and opportunities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于冒无保障风险，积极探索多元机会

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.quote: there definitely people that do have those hidden intentions... more than I should probably have been subjected to or worse to suffer.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay alert to people with hidden motives, even while recognizing most people are well-intentioned.
advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕别有用心之人，避免被恶意伤害

advice_items.quote: Just to know that it's never too late to get a fresh start.
advice_items.summary_en: Even when hitting rock bottom or facing public exile, remember it is never too late for a fresh start.
advice_items.summary_zh: 哪怕跌至谷底也永远有机会重新开始

advice_items.quote: No matter what, you have to honor your word... we tend to break a lot of promises to ourselves.
advice_items.summary_en: Honor your word no matter what, especially the promises you make to yourself, and stop letting yourself down.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无论如何都要信守承诺，别辜负自己

guests.zero_start_advice: 顺境时切忌以为财源永不枯竭，务必存钱以防低谷期拉长；遭遇质疑时坚信自己，不让未实现梦想的人否定你，勇于尝试没有保障的新机会；即便跌入谷底也永远来得及重新开始，信守对自己与他人的承诺。
